white_cutout_sticker_pip_storyteller.mechanic: Background V1 plays full-screen macro product interaction (pointing stick tapping words in baby sound book) while V2 overlays a background-removed cutout of Mother & Baby at bottom-left with a thick white sticker stroke border.

pantone_color_swatch_card_and_dual_pill_.mechanic: Top-right floating Pantone 4-color swatch card (e.g. COCOA / TRUFFLE palette extracted from the product) + cutout icon of the fabric motif (Dachshund dog) + Dual-Pill Title ([set ga gối] in sky-blue pill + [màu hottrend] in butter-yellow pill) + Retro Film Date Stamp (OCT 24 2026) on left edge.

hand_cover_pajama_to_glam_transition.mechanic: Starts in cute striped pajamas + plush headband holding luxury gift box -> covers camera lens with sleeve at 1.4s -> reveals full glam princess dress & makeup unboxing the castle box.

novelty_packaging_sashimi_basket_hook.mechanic: Places novelty product (Sashimi fish hair clip packaged in a supermarket meat tray) inside a mini pink supermarket basket -> Dual Pinned Comment Controversy -> Backpack Toss Durability Test ('nhét balo mang đi tùm lum vẫn lành lặn') -> Rebus Emoji Price ('49 🐟').

180_lay_flat_calculator_capacity_proof_a.mechanic: Unzips pencil case 180 degrees flat like a tray, packs 30 pens + fits a full Casio scientific calculator ('để được cả máy tính +-=') + floats tiny custom Chibi reaction stickers right above the 1-line subtitle (y = +0.52).

3_split_and_3x3_grid_collage_beat_flash.mechanic: 3-row horizontal split screen (GOOD / BYE / JUNE) + 3x3 9-panel synchronized video grid + halftone blue print flash on beat drops.

organic_handheld_3_point_rotation_zoom.mechanic: Replaces robotic linear zoom with 3-point Keyframe Scale + Micro-Rotation: KF1(t=0.0s, scale=1.0, rot=0deg) -> KF2(t=0.45s, scale=1.22, rot=-3.5deg) -> KF3(t=1.1s, scale=1.12, rot=+1.5deg) + CapCut Graph 'Chậm bên ngoài' (Ease-Out Cubic Bezier [0.16, 1.0, 0.3, 1.0]).

fixed_tripod_pendulum_zoom_out_con_thoi.mechanic: Keep phone locked on tripod (never push handheld). Start clip at Scale 1.35x on product, keyframe pull-out to 1.0x at 1.1s, then pendulum bounce back to 1.18x ('Con thoi').

invisible_hand_catch_product_swap_hook.mechanic: Empty hand reaches out and grabs air ('lấy đà trước 1 xíu'); cut on exact frame of finger closure to identical hand position holding the product (repeat across 2-3 products in first 2s).

scribble_draw_product_reveal_hook.mechanic: Overlay product clip on empty-hand clip, scribble over product silhouette with CapCut Crayon Brush + In-Animation 'Lần lượt vào' (1.1s), then pop real product into the hand.

pov_hand_skin_whitening_filter_formula.purpose: Brightens and smooths POV hands with rosy tone without distorting product colors.

multi_comment_social_proof_stack_plus_fo.mechanic: Stacks 3 real buyer comment screenshots sequentially (0.0s-3.0s) while stretching silk soap foam across forearm + drawing a heart in the thick white lather + micro CHR disclaimer at y=-0.78 ('*hiệu quả sản phẩm tuỳ cơ địa mỗi người*').

action_first_3_way_function_proof.mechanic: Demonstrates all 3 drinking modes of a thermos in the first 3.5s (straw pop -> direct sip lid -> pouring into cup lid) BEFORE showing the box unboxing.

sensory_proxy_visual_and_audio_proof.mechanic: When reviewing invisible performance (Microphone clarity or Fan wind power), open with 3-4 sensory proxy tests in 0.0s-3.5s: for Mic -> clip onto plastic wrap, water glass, chip bowl, ice spoon, keyboard; for Fan -> blow silver confetti toward lens & blow ripples on water bowl.

floating_part_pointer_specs.mechanic: Places tiny minimalist white typography specs ('Hybrid ANC 42dB', 'Driver 12.4mm', 'Leakproof 💦') tracked directly next to the physical part being touched.

sunlit_cross_section_and_syrup_drip_food.mechanic: Applies dark-wood/Bauhaus sunlight aesthetic to F&B: opens at 0.0s with two-handed cross-section split (purple blueberry + green matcha cheese core) or sunlit ice-stirring clink + slow-motion viscous honey drip from ceramic spoon.

3_color_match_cut_and_5x4_full_table_gri.mechanic: Holds item in fixed left-hand pose and match-cuts across 3 colorways (0.5s each) -> cuts to a 5x4 20-item full-table geometric grid.

water_glass_jump_and_vacuum_inflation_pr.mechanic: For mattresses/furniture: 0.0s body flop + jumping next to a glass of water on the mattress (zero spill proof) -> slicing vacuum plastic wrap so mattress self-inflates with loud air hiss -> stretched hand-span thickness proof ('độ dày 25cm').

micro_price_fluctuation_chr_shield.mechanic: Places tiny translucent white text at y=-0.78 ('Giá có thể thay đổi tuỳ thời điểm nha !') whenever a video mentions a flash-sale or cheap price ('chưa đến 1 cành', '152 viên'), preventing TikTok Shop price-mismatch penalties.
